title: One colon-list splitter: each site that splits PATH or GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES writes out IFS=: read -r -a, which stops at a newline and drops a trailing empty entry
body:
devbin splits PATH, and GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES, by writing out `IFS=: read -r -a <array> <<<"$list"` at each site that needs the entries. That reads one line, so an entry holding a newline ends the list there and every entry after it is lost, and it drops a trailing empty field, which a shell and git each read as an entry (in PATH, the current directory). Only clean checks its split, and its check counts lines, so it refuses a PATH holding a newline that a correct split would read, and passes one ending in `:` as though the empty entry were not there. So `brew_answer_state`, given a PATH with a newline in an entry ahead of Homebrew's bin, finds no devbin, and `use brew` says Homebrew's bin is not on PATH when it is; fullcycle's PATH watch and `git_ceiling` read no entry after a newline, where a shell and git read them; and `path_without` hands back a PATH that has lost a trailing empty entry. `git_repo_absent`'s comment already names the newline cut-off as a limit of its own. Raised by cc's critic-shell review of 0235; cc's read of main on 2026-10-27 added `git_ceiling` and clean.bats's arm.

## Cause

Measured on main at 15f2a973 under bash 5.3.20.

- The split, at each site: `lib/helpers:3853` (`brew_answer_state`), `lib/cmd/clean:54` (`_clean_path_elements`) and `lib/cmd/clean:85` (`_clean_validate_path`), `lib/cmd/fullcycle:319` (`_fullcycle_path_links`), `lib/helpers:2565` (`git_ceiling`), and `tests/lib/test_helper.bash:1382` (`path_without`, which joins its entries again at :1403).
- bash 5.3.20: `IFS=: read -r -a a <<<"a::b:"` gives `(a "" b)`, and `IFS=: read -r -a a <<<$'/usr/bin:/odd\ndir:/opt/homebrew/bin'` gives `(/usr/bin /odd)`.
- `lib/cmd/clean:85-92`: clean's other instrument (:87) counts the lines `tr ':' '\n'` makes. For `a::b:` it agrees with the split on the fields less the trailing empty one; for the list holding a newline it disagrees, and clean refuses with "PATH scan is unreliable".
- `lib/cmd/fullcycle:356`: the watch loops over the entries the split kept.
- `lib/helpers:2608-2612`: `git_repo_absent`'s comment says it "reads GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES only up to a newline".
- `tests/unit/clean.bats:289`: the arm that breaks clean's splitter does it by a sed of that exact line, and checks that the sed took (:292), so it moves with the split.
- The probe (`~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/174/probe-0235-followups.sh`, which sources main's `lib/helpers` against a fixture and runs no bats): with PATH `<home>/.local/bin:/odd\ndir:<prefix>/bin:/usr/bin:/bin` and a linked keg, `brew_answer_state` answers `offpath <prefix>/bin/devbin`.

## Fix

One splitter in `lib/helpers`, beside `physical_dir`, that splits a list on `:` alone into an array the caller names: every field kept, empty ones and a trailing one included, and a newline kept inside the field that holds it. Each site above calls it, and keeps its own reading of empty and relative entries. clean's other instrument counts the separators and adds one, so it stays independent of the splitter and agrees with it on any list; clean.bats's arm breaks the splitter where clean now calls it; and `git_repo_absent`'s comment loses its newline limit.

## Done when

1. `brew_answer_state`, given a PATH with a newline in an entry ahead of Homebrew's bin and a linked keg, answers `brew`. An arm, red on main where it answers `offpath`, and green at the fix.
2. `git_ceiling` reads a ceiling written after an entry holding a newline, as git does. An arm, red on main, and green at the fix.
3. fullcycle's PATH watch reads an entry written after an entry holding a newline. An arm, red on main, and green at the fix.
4. clean reads a PATH holding a newline without refusing. An arm, red on main where clean refuses, and green at the fix. clean.bats's broken-splitter arm still refuses, removing nothing, with the splitter broken where clean calls it.
5. No file in bin, lib or tests writes out its own colon split: `git grep` for `IFS=:` at the fix finds the splitter and the joins alone.
6. helpers.bats, clean.bats, fullcycle.bats, use.bats and targetdir.bats pass at the fix under BSD and GNU, beside the tree scans and help.
7. CI's run on the pushed head is green on Test on Ubuntu.

## Deferred to 0.1.17

hv deferred this to devbin 0.1.17 on 2026-10-28 ("defer E to 0.1.17, close 0274 and 0278", relayed verbatim by molt-vc at 18:11Z by date -u). It was built in cc's stage 8 bank for 0.1.16 (s8-rebuild adc44833 in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/s8/s8a/build, on dc's e3c9c8bb), which had not finished its checks or run. It is not started for 0.1.17: the bank is kept as a starting point and is rebuilt on 0.1.17's base, then checked, run and reviewed as new.

## Resolution

- PATH and GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES are split by one splitter, colon_split in lib/helpers, which keeps every entry: an empty one, a trailing one and one holding a newline. use brew, git_ceiling, clean's PATH scan, fullcycle's watch and path_without read through it, and path_absolute_entries gives path_hit and path_searches the one list of absolute entries.
- path_without, a subshell function so it can source lib/helpers, carries shellcheck's SC2030 disable on its entry swap, with its reason, so the lint gate is clean.
- Landed on main: `d0d4680e`, `0b72aa35` (the second is the fix for hv's run 20261029-1304).
- Arms: helpers.bats, colon_split keeping every entry and git_ceiling past an entry holding a newline; use.bats, use brew past such an entry; clean.bats and fullcycle.bats, the PATH scan and the watch past one; contract.bats, no line but the one join shape sets IFS to a colon. contract.bats's lint gate arm holds the corpus clean.
- Desk evidence: hv's full run 20261029-1314, 2826 counted, ran every arm above ok, after run 20261029-1313 ran the lint gate arm ok at the fix.
- Run 20261029-1336 (`--failed`) ran that run's two reds, neither in this issue's arms, ok at their fixes, 2 of 2, so main at 5085ae24 is green.
